projects.name: VLMEvalKit
projects.description: An all-in-one evaluation toolkit for large vision-language and multimodal models. It connects model inference, benchmark execution, scoring, and result comparison in one reproducible workflow used by both researchers and practitioners.

projects.name: OpenCompass
projects.description: A comprehensive platform for evaluating large language and multimodal models. Its modular configs, task scheduling, evaluators, and reporting tools make broad and reproducible model comparisons easier to run and extend.

projects.name: PYSKL
projects.description: A unified toolbox for skeleton-based action recognition, with strong baselines spanning GCN- and CNN-based methods. It packages training recipes, pretrained models, and benchmark results so new methods can be compared on consistent footing.

projects.name: MMAction2
projects.description: OpenMMLab's modular video-understanding toolbox for action recognition, localization, skeleton-based recognition, and related tasks. It offers reusable components, extensive model coverage, and standardized training and inference pipelines.

Visual-RFT: Visual Reinforcement Fine-Tu.summary: Visual-RFT brings reinforcement fine-tuning with verifiable rewards to visual perception tasks, improving data-efficient adaptation with limited examples.

Redundancy Principles for MLLMs Benchmar.summary: This work quantifies dimension, instance, and cross-benchmark redundancy and turns the findings into practical principles for efficient MLLM evaluation.

Condor: Enhance LLM Alignment with Knowl.summary: Condor synthesizes and refines knowledge-intensive instruction data to strengthen language-model alignment without relying on a fixed seed dataset.

ShareGPT4Video: Improving Video Understa.summary: ShareGPT4Video scales detailed video captioning to improve both video-language understanding and text-to-video generation.

ProSA: Assessing and Understanding the P.summary: ProSA measures prompt sensitivity at the instance level and analyzes why semantically equivalent instructions can produce unstable LLM performance.

Dg-stgcn: Dynamic spatial-temporal model.summary: DG-STGCN learns dynamic spatial graphs and multi-scale temporal structure instead of relying on a fixed skeleton topology.

TransRank: Self-supervised Video Represe.summary: TransRank reframes transformation recognition as relative ranking to learn stronger self-supervised video representations from temporal and spatial transformations.
